findings.passage: Yes, I do support the amendment. I support Amendment 7 for a variety of reasons. One, I think it's good that we clarify and codify within our Constitution that only citizens are to vote in our elections, which many would say is already the case. But it's good to be, I think, redundant, especially when it comes to something so sacred as who is voting in our election.
findings.note: Interview answer (KSMU, Informed Voter Coalition) on the 2024 amendment limiting voting to citizens and banning ranked-choice voting. He supports writing the citizen-only rule into the constitution.
